name: What are common closing costs associated with buying a luxury penthouse?

mainEntity.name: What are common closing costs associated with buying a luxury penthouse?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common closing costs for luxury penthouses include title insurance, escrow fees, appraisal fees, lender fees (if financing), and potentially a condominium association estoppel fee. In Florida, buyers also typically pay documentary stamp taxes on the mortgage and note. These costs can amount to a significant percentage of the purchase price. It's crucial to obtain a detailed estimate early in the process to avoid surprises and budget accordingly. We provide clear breakdowns to ensure transparency throughout the transaction.
